explication: Nodyx is a self-hosted community platform: members use its web interface for discussion and collaboration, while the instance serves community features and state. The documented product also includes customizable homepages and extensions, moderation, streaming tools, and peer-to-peer networking. The graph groups these capabilities by subsystem and includes the central moderation workflow. Most implementation details were not sampled, so edges rely on README-level capability statements; they do not assert unverified internal calls.
